title: Thyroid FNA, Bethesda IV
notice: Synthetic and AI-written. Needs review by a pathologist before being used to score anything (issue #22).

keys.span: Bethesda category 4, which means a follicular neoplasm
keys.correct: Bethesda category IV is follicular neoplasm.
keys.source_hint: Bethesda System for Reporting Thyroid Cytopathology 2023
keys.speaker: doctor

keys.span: That means the needle test shows it's cancer.
keys.issue: Bethesda IV is not a cancer diagnosis.
keys.correct: Bethesda IV means follicular neoplasm. A needle sample can't tell a benign follicular adenoma from a carcinoma, because that needs the whole capsule examined after surgery. The cancer risk is roughly a quarter to a third.
keys.source_hint: Bethesda System for Reporting Thyroid Cytopathology 2023
keys.speaker: doctor

keys.span: The next step is surgery to take out half of your thyroid.
keys.issue: Omits molecular testing as an option.
keys.correct: Molecular testing of the FNA sample is an option that can refine the risk and sometimes avoid surgery. Lobectomy also gives the diagnosis.
keys.speaker: doctor
